faq.question: How do you scope a project before charging anything?
faq.answer: We run an upfront diagnostic conversation to dissect the exact operational problem. You receive a concrete proposal with architecture options, fixed milestones, and clear deliverables before any commitment is made.

faq.question: Can we integrate with our existing legacy systems and databases?
faq.answer: Yes. Most of our deployments bridge legacy ERPs, internal SQL databases, and third-party APIs. We design modern interfaces and automation layers that run smoothly on top of your existing infrastructure without forcing disruptive overhauls.

faq.question: What happens if our operational requirements evolve midway?
faq.answer: We engineer in atomic, weekly sprints with live staging deployments. You test working software each week, allowing us to reprioritize backlog items and pivot requirements without throwing away progress or blowing up timelines.
